Dog tails are either the most honest mood indicators on the planet or just absolute chaos propellers attached to dogs who have completely lost control of them. Ranking the top 7 dog tail core moments on the internet, because watching a dog get taken out by their own wagging tail is pure comedy gold! Dogs like to act cool and collected, but the second something exciting happens, total tail chaos breaks loose. From a dog knocking over a whole table of snacks with one happy swing to a dog spinning in circles chasing their own tail, these wagging legends will leave you dying of laughter! 🐶〰️ Did you know: Dogs wag their tails to the right when they feel happy or confident and to the left when they feel anxious or unsure, so a tail wag isn’t always a sign of friendliness. That’s why your dog’s tail is basically a mood compass most humans never learn to read! 🐾 #fyp #funnyanimals #dogsoftiktok
